prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite-component atlas for Drain Damage, richly shaded crisp pixel-art side-scrolling sewer game. 1536x1024 landscape. NO text, labels, checkerboard, background, scene, characters or enclosing panels. Six isolated horizontal components arranged in six rows with generous transparent gaps. Each component occupies x80..1456. Row1 y30..170: sparse turquoise and pale ivory water surface ripple streaks, horizontal foreshortened perspective, broken irregular wisps, transparent between streaks, suitable continuous leftward flow overlay. Row2 y200..320: thin shattered ivory porcelain wet rim, viewed from slightly above, top edge straight overall with tiny chipped irregularities; dark turquoise wet seams, no tall wall. Row3 y350..480: shallow recessed dark navy teal inner wall strip, strongest dark at bottom, small chipped stone texture, straight horizontal rectangle entirely opaque internally, no foam. Row4 y510..650: thin white turquoise foam curling inward over a horizontal lip into darkness, short little curls only, transparent above/below, NOT a tall waterfall curtain. Row5 y680..800: opaque extremely dark navy almost black recessed depth texture, seamless subdued texture, no bright features, straight full horizontal strip. Row6 y830..990: sparse secondary small turquoise current swirls and broken surface reflections, transparent gaps, same material and pixel scale as row1. All pieces separate, no connecting elements. Stylized game pixel shading, controlled highlights, readable at reduced size. This atlas will be cropped into independent layers, keep each strictly within designated row. Preserve real transparent alpha everywhere outside individual components.

Edit this atlas only: remove ALL diffuse colored background, atmospheric haze and glow between pieces. Outside the six isolated rows of actual objects and ripple marks must be exactly transparent alpha0, including between individual ripple streaks. Preserve six components, pixel art colors, positions and dimensions. Opaque full interiors for rectangular dark strips rows3 and5 (alpha255). No gray/teal background anywhere. Preserve narrow foam/ripple antialiasing only on edges, no broad translucent halos. Transparent sprite sheet for direct compositing onto existing bright turquoise water. Do not add text.

Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent game sprite atlas 1536x1024. Rich crisp pixel art industrial brass and dark steel sewer machinery, teal patina and warm ivory highlights. Three separated components only on truly transparent background, no haze or scene. Top row y100..300: straight horizontal ceiling I-beam rail spanning x60..1470, side view, constant cross section, continuous dark running groove, no perspective vanishing point, no chains, no trolley, no text. Middle left x100..500 y400..800: heavy bolted wall mounting bracket for rail, side front orthographic game view, squared U-shaped clamp. Middle right x850..1250 y400..800: matching right end stop bracket with thick bumper and bolts. Pixel-art game graphics not photorealism. These mount the existing brass winch trolley. Separate components generous gaps, actual alpha0 surrounding, no diffuse glow.
